content: Tsanitsuni kemɨtiuyɨkɨhɨa

Mɨixa tukari 'anukayaku, tɨriku 'itsanarienekaku, Tsanitsuni tsipu nunutsi 'uwiyaka yu'ɨya hetsɨa kaneyani. Heta'aka mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Ne'ɨya kiita nepeutɨa. Peru 'uka paapaya pɨka'ipitɨa meutahanikɨ,
mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Ne mɨpaɨ nepɨtimaikai, kename pe'ixani'eriekai, 'ahamiku nepuwitɨtɨa. ¿Matsi waɨkawa taruya kametinake? Kenanuwitɨki, kurieyatsie mieme.
Tsanitsuni mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Hikɨrixɨa heitserie nepexeiya tsepa piritsiteutsixi kenemɨwaruyuri.
Hikɨ kaneyani yeuta kaniwaretiwiya haika tsienituyari kauxaitsi, kaniwarakatapiexɨani wakwaxitsie yuhuhutatame, hikɨta 'utsi tatɨkaime kaniwaranawɨtɨiriexɨani,
hikɨ 'utsi kaniutaiyaxɨani kauxaitsi kaniwarutatuani piritsiteutsixi wa'etsita. Tɨriku naitsarie kanayetaixɨani mukuha'aritsiekairi meta 'akuxi 'amɨti'ukai, naitɨ kaxie meta huriwa.

Kepauka piritsiteutsixi memuti'iwautɨkɨ: «¿Kemɨ'ane pɨtiuyuri?», mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniutahɨawarieni: «Tsanitsuni katiniuyurieni, Timinati kiekame munieya, 'ɨyaya minawairikɨ hamikuya pɨta muwitɨtɨakɨ». 'Ayumieme piritsiteutsixi 'ɨyayatɨkai mekaniutataiya meta paapaya.
Peru Tsanitsuni mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Mɨya xemɨte'uyurikɨ, nepɨkaka'uxipieni xete'ayukatuayuke».
Hikɨ kwinimieme tiha'atɨ kaniwarutakwini, yuwaɨkawame kaniwareuyehɨani. Mɨyatiuyurieka kaneyani terɨta 'Etami 'aiyaritsie.
Piritsiteutsixi mekanekɨne Kura kwieyaritsie mekanitiyaxe, Rehi 'aurie.

Teɨteri Kura kwieyaritsie kiekatari mɨpaɨ meteniwaruta'iwawiya: ―¿Titayari xetatekwiku tame? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Tame Tsanitsuni tepukuwautɨwe temenutahɨanikɨ, yaxeikɨa temiyurienikɨ kemɨtatsiheyuri mɨkɨ tame.

Hikɨ Kura kwieyaritsie kiekatari haika miriyari teɨteri mekanekɨne terɨta 'Etami 'aiyaritsie mɨpaɨ Tsanitsuni mekateniutahɨawe: ―¿Pekatimate piritsiteutsixi memɨtate'aitɨa? ¿Titayari mɨya petiyuriene? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Matsi ne kememɨnetsiheyuri mɨpaɨ xeikɨata ne nepɨwareyuri.
Mɨkɨta mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Tame tematsihɨanike tepeyekɨ, tematsiyetuanike piritsiteutsixi wahetsɨa. Tsanitsuni mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Yaxekeneutiyuakatsɨ xɨka xeme xekanetsihemiekuni.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Kamɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ pɨ'aneni, tematsihɨani xeikɨa, wahetsɨa tematsiheyetuani. Tepɨkamatsihemieni. Hikɨ mekanihɨani kaunari hutamekɨ hehekwamekɨ, terɨta mekanewayehana.

Rehi 'aye'aximekaku, piritsiteutsixi mekanayekɨne me'enukunakeke memɨte'ayu'iwani hepaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ. 'Ana Yawé 'iyarieya hetsiena kaninuani tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ, kaunarikɨ mɨhɨakai mamayatsie rinu mɨtata'ini hepaɨ kaniutiyɨni, yumamatsie mɨhɨakai kaniuxɨne.
Puxu 'ayekwaiya hekwame 'utaxeiyaka mɨkɨkɨ kaniwarukwini xeimiriyari.
Hikɨ Tsanitsuni mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni:
Kepauka mɨtiutahayewaxɨ mɨpaɨ tikuxatatɨ 'ayekwai nehɨani mana katiniuterɨwa Xamati-Rehi.

Waɨkawa meuharimɨkɨkaikɨ, Yawé kaniutahɨawe karima: «'Ekɨ pepɨtiuyuri 'ikɨ mati'uximayatsiriwame mɨrayu'iwakɨ. ¿Kamɨtsɨta hikɨ hariyakɨ netimɨni, 'ikɨ xitekiya 'inɨariyari memɨkahexeiya wapɨretsu nerayani?»

Hikɨ Kakaɨyari kwiepa haa kanetinetɨani Rehi kemɨti'ane, muwa haa kanitinetɨani watixawakaku. Kepauka Tsanitsuni mutihari, kaniutatɨrɨkaxɨani 'aixɨa katineka'erietɨyani. 'Ayumieme mɨkɨ haixa hikɨ mana 'akuxi Rehi mɨtinena, «Kemɨ'ane mutahiwaxɨ haixaya» katiniuterɨwarieni.
Tsanitsuni manuyehaitɨa kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni xeitewiyari wiyari 'ixaheritsixi wahetsie, kepauka piritsiteutsixi 'ixaheritsixi memɨtewa'aitɨakai.
